research.notes: The organization's own website (tvsra.org, Squarespace) could not be fetched because of a TLS certificate mismatch, so website, phone, email and address were left null rather than unverified. Sources do not explicitly mention Oakland; the link to the Oakland Athletic League rests on name, Sebastopol location and the mission of supplying officials to schools. impala.digital lists a Forestville, CA address while ProPublica lists Sebastopol; Sebastopol (matching the agenda) is used. California entity number and SAM UEI were not checked.

profile.summary: A nonprofit association of soccer referees. Its stated mission is to provide soccer officials to member schools and other organizations, and to promote the game of soccer to educate the schools and student athletes it serves.
